description: We are team of enthusiastic engineering students passionate about technology, innovation and problem solving. Our interest include software development and innovative technology.
summary:
Our project showcase NASA’s abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars through 3D animated video and AI generated audio . Narrating story about Lunar Module’s descent stage, Lunar roving vehicle, Mars pathfinder lander , Sojourner , Spirit  and Opportunity rovers and their purposes and scientific contributions.
Our project address the problem by making abandoned equipment into engaging visual experience and helping Young space dreamer to understand history and science behind space exploration.
This project is important because these machines have contributed enormously to our understanding of Lunar and Martian geology, surface conditions , atmosphere and presence of water . Although now they are not working but their  scientific contribution remain valuable and stand as monuments to human curiosity, courage and spirit of exploration.
details:
1. What does our project do and how?

We developed a 3D animated video with AI generated audio narration showing NASA’s discarded equipment on the moon and mars , including the Lunar module’s descent stage , LRV , Mars Pathfinder, Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity. It explains their purposes and scientific contributions through visual storytelling.

2. Benefits

·       Makes space science easier and more interesting to understand.

·       Creates awareness about historical space missions.

·       Inspires  students to explore astronomy and space technology.           

·       Preserves the scientific legacy of these missions.

 

3. Intended Impact

To help people understand that non-operational space equipment still holds enormous scientific and historical value and to inspire future generations of space explorers.

 

4. Tools Used

Blender – 3D modelling and animation .

AI audio – Luvvoice app (text to speech)

Video Editing Software – Clip-champ software.

 

5.  Creativity and Innovation

We combine 3D animation which attracts  children and motivate them to explore space .We have used  text to speech app for the audio . The story is to bring forgotten space equipment back into spotlight as monuments of human exploration.

 

6.  Factors Considered

·       Scientific and historical accuracy.

·       Animation quality and visual appeal

·       Clear audio narration.

·       Educational value for young learners .

·       Time and technical feasibility.
